request: One consistent card menu; preserve large cards and text; show real desktop and mobile examples before publication.
scope: All available direct card families and levels
Prepared grammar, quick and conversation cards
Same choices in fixed desktop sidebar and narrow-screen dialog
Preserve exact card deck, turn, attempt and revealed example when switching and resuming

design.narrowScreens: Visible Kaartspellen button opens the same menu on request; no automatic slide-out

checks.cardMenu: 24 available direct family/route cases; prepared families; 1440/1024/390/320; targets >=44px; no horizontal clipping; keyboard close and focus return; saved progress and reload
checks.grammar: Full 1440 reviewed tasks across five game surfaces, split into two local shards (7200 renders)
regressions: npm run smoke (grammar shard 1/2 plus separate shard 2/2)
checks.build: See evidence/build.log; run after preview source commit

reviewRounds.finding: Prepared cards had no sidebar and both alternative menu buttons were hidden.
reviewRounds.resolution: Use one shared menu and binder; keep the existing dialog and lesson preparation.

findings: Attempt state lost on direct family switch
Current menu choice could scroll offscreen after resize
Dark theme group labels on a light panel needed contrast
resolution: Restore round using current family key rather than previous APP.last
Reveal current choice on initial mount or panel-size change only
Explicit dark ink on the retained light panel

reviewRounds.result: Targeted menu/progress and navigation tests pass; actual desktop/mobile/dark screenshots inspected. Full local regression checks recorded in evidence.

limitations: No new teacher classroom usability trial or physical touch-device trial.
Long cards retain vertical scrolling; text is deliberately not reduced.
DigiBord style-reference folder unavailable locally; retained current approved app typography and controls.
